components.name: MinimalArchivalFrame
components.when_to_use: marking the shot as archive while it plays untouched — one slate line, an optional date or archive under it, no grain and no frame drawn
components.when_not_to_use: the footage itself should carry the archival treatment — grain, gate flicker, sprockets (ArchivalFrame); a still presented as an exhibit with a caption (MinimalFramedExhibit); a date with no slate line (MinimalDateStamp)

text.description: the slate line, e.g. 'Soviet newsreel, reel 3'

subtext.description: the year, or the archive it came from

components.name: MinimalChapterCard
components.when_to_use: a full-screen act break between sections — a small kicker naming the part and one line of title, centred over the shot
components.when_not_to_use: the video's opening title (KineticTitle); a heading the narration should not stop for; a person's name (MinimalNamePlate)

components.name: MinimalAnimatedCounter
components.when_to_use: the narration lands a single figure worth dwelling on — the number counts up over a label and nothing else is on screen
components.when_not_to_use: two values being compared (ComparisonSplit); three or more (BarChart); a figure that should sit in a corner while the shot continues (StatTag)

components.name: MinimalDateStamp
components.when_to_use: establishing when — and optionally where — a shot happens, as one line the narration runs underneath
components.when_not_to_use: several dates in sequence (Timeline); a date that is itself the figure the beat is about (MinimalAnimatedCounter); locating a place on a map (SatelliteLocate)

text.description: pre-formatted for the language of the video, e.g. '31 January 1943'

components.name: MinimalDocumentCard
components.when_to_use: a written source read as text — an order, a telegram, a signed note — set as plain lines under its title, one line revealed at a time
components.when_not_to_use: the paper itself is the point, with stamp, signature or typewriter face (DocumentCard); a spoken line (QuoteBlock); the video's own list of reasons (BulletList)

title.description: what the document is, e.g. 'Order No. 227'

items.description: the lines of the document, quoted or condensed

components.name: MinimalFramedExhibit
components.when_to_use: a photograph or artefact is already on screen and needs naming — the caption set beside it, with an optional credit, and no frame drawn around the image
components.when_not_to_use: the image needs a museum frame, a polaroid or a plate around it (FramedExhibit); the shot should read as moving archive (MinimalArchivalFrame); a written document (MinimalDocumentCard)

title.description: the caption — what the viewer is looking at

body.description: one sentence of detail, only if the caption cannot carry it

components.name: MinimalNamePlate
components.when_to_use: introducing a person while the narration continues — the name on the line, role or years under it
components.when_not_to_use: a place (SatelliteLocate); a term (MinimalDefinitionCard); a section heading (MinimalChapterCard); quoting what the person said (QuoteBlock)

subtext.description: role, and the years if they earn their place

components.name: MinimalDefinitionCard
components.when_to_use: the narration introduces a technical term the viewer is unlikely to know and defines it — the term as the heading, the definition under it
components.when_not_to_use: a claim or a statistic rather than a term (FactCard); a person's name and role (MinimalNamePlate); a quoted line (QuoteBlock)

body.description: the definition, one sentence, in the language of the video

footnote.description: origin or literal sense, e.g. 'German: cauldron'
